Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a premium editorial hero illustration for a French engineering devlog about "2brain", a personal cloud knowledge graph and RAG system. Wide landscape 3:2. Pure solid WHITE #FFFFFF background edge to edge, flat crisp design, ample white negative space, meticulous alignment, thin cool-gray connections, elegant contemporary sans-serif typography in dark charcoal. Restrained deep blue and sage green accent colors. Professional understated high-end technical publication. No gradients, no paper texture, no shadows, no glass, no 3D, no frame around the whole canvas.
Composition: a beautifully balanced connected knowledge graph across the center, with three compact source document cards on the left connected to a small cluster of labeled concept nodes in the center, connected to a curated project note card on the right. Use large, perfectly legible French labels only: left source cards "Article", "PDF · OCR", "Vidéo"; central concept nodes "RAG", "Agents", "Convex"; right note card title "Projet de recherche" with three tiny thin horizontal content lines and two subtle blue citation marks. Some minor unlabeled nodes establish the network without clutter. At top-left a small editorial label "2brain", below it the heading "Des sources aux connaissances". Below the graph, understated caption in the design "Capturer · Relier · Retrouver". Clear visual hierarchy and generous margins. Draw conceptual document cards, NOT a screenshot, no browser chrome, no fake software UI, no buttons. No robot or anatomical brain, no neon, no logos other than the plain text 2brain. High fidelity typography and balanced visual design. All text in French with correct accents.

Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a precise premium French technical architecture infographic for 2brain. Wide landscape 3:2, pure white #FFFFFF edge-to-edge background. Flat Swiss editorial design, elegant sans-serif dark charcoal typography, generous white negative space, hairline cool gray outlines, restrained dark blue arrows and sage green highlights. Extremely crisp, clean, professional premium diagram. No gradients, shadows, 3D, texture or mock browser.
Top headline "Un socle intégré, des clients réactifs".
Architecture organized as three generous columns. LEFT has four small white outlined cards vertically: "Extension Chrome", "Web React", "CLI", "MCP". A fine shared bus connects these four cards to the central backend. CENTER largest outlined card title "Convex" with subtitle "BaaS". Inside use six readable rows exactly: "Base documentaire ACID", "Stockage de fichiers", "Index vectoriels + full-text", "Backend TypeScript réactif", "Workflows / jobs", "OCR images / PDF". RIGHT upper card "Workers externes" with two lines "Extraction" and "Traitements IA". Below it a small connected card "Claude / Codex".
Below CENTER a separate compact card "Services IA" containing "Embeddings · Reranking" and "Jev via OpenRouter", connected only to Convex.
Between Convex and Workers, two distinct horizontal directed arrows: Convex → Workers labeled "Abonnement aux jobs"; Workers → Convex labeled "Progression / résultats". On the left-side bus the Web React connection is bidirectional and has the label "Temps réel" beside it. No direct connection between Chrome and external models. No link between Services IA and Workers. Do not imply graph is a separate database. OCR belongs inside Convex. Ensure no crossing arrows or overlaps, labels are fully readable, ample margins. All text exact French, no additional text or decorations.

Use case: infographic-diagram. Create an elegant premium conceptual editorial illustration in French for a devlog about knowledge consolidation with agents. Wide landscape 3:2. Pure WHITE #FFFFFF background edge-to-edge. Flat Swiss-inspired editorial diagram, lots of whitespace, dark charcoal sans-serif type, restrained deep blue and sage green accents, subtle cool gray hairline borders. No gradients, shadows, 3D, paper texture, fake screenshot, browser chrome or fake software controls.
Headline upper left: "Consolider, avec des preuves".
Three clear stages connected left to right across the page. First stage heading "Sources", with two minimal document cards, one marked "Source A", the other "Source B"; blue underlined text fragments represented by abstract straight lines. Middle stage heading "Proposition", with a larger editorial note card headed "Synthèse enrichie". Inside it neutral short gray text lines and exactly one pale sage highlighted line with a blue citation marker "[1]". Under this card place a small neat annotation "Passages justificatifs" with two numbered source markers "[1]" and "[2]" connected by fine blue lines back to the source cards. Right stage heading "Validation", with a thin outlined circle containing a simple human profile icon, then the text "Revue humaine". Beneath that a final compact note card labeled "Version publiée", reached by a sage arrow from the review circle. Arrow from Sources to Proposition; arrow from Proposition to review circle; no bypass from sources or proposal directly to final published note. At bottom one small editorial line "Comparer · Vérifier · Valider". The scene is clearly a conceptual workflow, NOT an actual app UI. Perfect alignment, readable large labels, precise arrows without intersections, no invented metrics, no approved rubber stamp, no brain or robot.
